title: Lucky Bhaskar
desc: A struggling bank teller takes a chance on a shady investment scheme with an unproven partner. Later, as his fortunes rise, so does his ego, driving him to take on increasingly reckless risks.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Mr. X
desc: A renegade operative competes with the clock to prevent a nuclear disaster.

title: Pandavulu Pandavulu Thummeda
desc: Two ex-lovers are reunited by a young girl, Honey. When everything falls into place and the adopted children of the lovers agree to their union, Honey gets kidnapped.

title: Dhada
desc: An engineer falls in love with the daughter of a businessman. However, he gets embroiled in the affairs of a human trafficking gang while his lover's marriage is fixed elsewhere.

title: Okkadunnadu
desc: Kiran, a man who is in Mumbai to sell a house, adds his name to a hospital's blood donor list. However, he soon finds himself the target of a mafia leader who wants his heart for a vital transplant.

title: Uu Kodathara? Ulikki Padathara?
desc: Rayudu, the present head of an erstwhile royal family, owns a palace which is also home to a few ghosts. A malicious ghost tries to ruin Rayudu's daughter's wedding to settle an old score.

title: Mirchi
desc: Manasa falls in love with Jai after he helps her and manages to win the hearts of her family with his good deeds. However, she is unaware that he belongs to a rival family.

title: Tholi Prema
desc: Fate offers Aditya and Varsha the opportunity to rekindle their youthful romance years after personality differences compelled them to go their separate ways.

title: Vinaya Vidheya Rama
desc: Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.

title: Inkokkadu
desc: Love invents a lethal drug and gives it to terrorist outfits, who use it to kill Indian officials in Kuala Lumpur. When RAW officers find a love emblem tattoo on his neck, they start investigating.
